description: Zivon Lithium Battery for Inverter, 12V 105Ah (12.8v 105ah), LiFePo4, Wall Mount, BMS, for Home Power Backup - Distributed/Packaged by Zivon. Product Details: Upgrade your home power backup with the ZIVON Lithium Inverter Battery, a premium alternative to traditional 12v lead-acid systems. Engineered with cutting-edge LiFePo4 technology, this battery is recognised as one of the safest battery technologies available, eliminating fire risks whilst offering a significantly longer lifespan of up to 15 years. Unlike lead-acid batteries that suffer from power delivery drops as they drain, the ZIVON series ensures consistent power delivery throughout the discharge cycle. With a high capacity of 12.8V 105Ah, it provides a robust 1344W power backup and supports over 3000+ designed life charge cycles, outlasting standard batteries that typically fail after 50-150 cycles. The battery features a minimalist and sleek metal body with an inbuilt display for real-time monitoring. Its ultra-slim profile (only 9.3 centimetres thick from wall) is designed for wall mounting, allowing you to save valuable floor space. This battery offers universal support for every 12V solar or home inverter up to 1500VA, including major brands like Luminous, Microtek, and Exide. It includes a built-in BMS (Battery Management System) and an active balancer for enhanced safety and longevity. Lightweight and cost-effective in the long run, ZIVON is the ultimate choice for modern home energy solutions.
